第26章 巴统港-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

王建新走在巴统的街头，感受着黑海吹来的风。湿润的、温暖的，跟莫斯科那种干冷完全不一样。他看了看路边的树，有的已经冒了新芽，草地上也有了绿色。

“这应该是亚热带地区。”王建新心里想着，“这边的植物应该比较多吧？”

他观察了一下街上跑的车，还是那些苏联常见的牌子——拉达、莫斯科人、嘎斯，没什么新鲜的。他从空间里取出嘎斯69，继续开着车在城里转悠。

巴统不算特别大。跟莫斯科没法比，但比乌兰巴托热闹。街上人多，穿着薄外套，不像北方那样裹得严严实实。

王建新开着车在城里转了一圈，发现这里农业比较发达。郊外是大片的农田和果园，热带湿润气候，很适合种植。他一边开一边看着海面上，港口那边停着不少大小船只，货轮、渔船、客船，桅杆林立。

“都想搞一艘船了。”王建新看着那些船，心里痒痒的。但想了想，实在是空间没地方放。那么大一艘船，总不能放在河里吧？算了，以后再说。

开着开着，他路过一个很大的种植基地。基地占地很广，围墙围着，里面有温室大棚，有露天果园，有试验田，看着挺正规的。门口有牌子，写着格鲁吉亚文和俄文，大概是什么农业科研机构。

王建新找了个没人的地方，把车收进空间，然后潜入进去。

一进去，他就被里面的东西吸引住了。

水果树种类真多。橘子、柑橘、橙子、柠檬、葡萄柚，一棵一棵的，挂满了果子。金黄的橘子，橙红的柑橘，黄澄澄的柠檬，压得树枝都弯了。还有葡萄、无花果、石榴、柿子、苹果、梨和李子，好多都已经成熟了，果香扑鼻。

再往里走，是大片的浆果区。草莓、覆盆子、黑莓、蓝莓，一垄一垄的，红的黑的紫的，密密麻麻地挂在藤蔓上。王建新摘了一颗草莓放进嘴里，甜，带着一点点酸，好吃。

最让他惊喜的是——茶叶树。一大片茶园，整整齐齐的茶树，绿油油的叶子在月光下泛着光。牌子上面写着品种：红茶、绿茶、乌龙茶、花果茶、黑莓茶，各种都有。

“幸亏都有介绍。”王建新一边看一边记，“要不他干脆不知道这些是什么东西。”

那边还有大片的蔬菜区。土豆、西红柿、黄瓜、茄子、甜椒、豆角、秋葵、卷心菜、洋葱、大蒜、胡萝卜，品种真全啊。

“这看来也是一个科研性质的地方。”王建新在基地里转了一圈，面积这么大，果树、茶树、蔬菜、浆果，什么都种，应该也是植物园之类的机构。

趁着天黑，赶紧动手。

他先来到果树区，橘子、柑橘、橙子、柠檬、葡萄柚，每样挖了五棵。葡萄、无花果、石榴、柿子、苹果、梨、李子，每样五棵。这些树有大有小，大的已经长成大树了，根团很大，挖起来费劲。但王建新炼气三层，力气大，一铁锹下去，土就翻起来了。挖了两个多小时，终于把所有的果树苗都挖了出来，收入空间。

然后是茶树。红茶、绿茶、乌龙茶、花果茶、黑莓茶，每样五棵。茶树比果树好挖，根不深，一锹就能起出来。他把茶树苗跟果树苗放在一起，等回去再种。

浆果区他每样也搞了一些。草莓、覆盆子、黑莓、蓝莓，连根带土挖出来，装在盆里。

搞完了果树和茶树，他又跑到蔬菜区。蔬菜不用挖苗，直接摘成熟的就行。西红柿、黄瓜、茄子、甜椒、豆角、秋葵、卷心菜，摘了一大堆。洋葱、大蒜、胡萝卜，连根拔起来。然后把一些蔬菜苗移植到空间里——选长得壮实的，连土带根挖出来，种在空间河边的空地上。

“先搞了好多成熟的蔬菜，移植在空间里一部分。”

继续在基地里转悠。这么大一个种植园，还有好多认不得的树木和灌木。有的是观赏性的，有的是经济林木，王建新也不管那么多，看着大小合适的、长得漂亮的，挖了几棵，准备种在空间河边，就当绿化了。

再剩下的，他看到了大片的小麦、大麦。一望无际的麦田，麦穗已经黄了，快收割了。

“这些就不需要了。”王建新摇了摇头。空间里已经种了小麦，够吃了。而且从苏联收来的面粉堆成山，几辈子都吃不完。

他转了一圈，找到了办公区域。一溜平房，有办公室、实验室、仓库。他先找到仓库，发现里面有种子库——各种蔬菜种子、浆果种子、水果种子，分门别类地存放在柜子里。他翻了翻，找到了西红柿、黄瓜、茄子、甜椒、豆角、秋葵、卷心菜、洋葱、大蒜、胡萝卜的种子，还有草莓、西梅、蓝莓、覆盆子的种子。

“全部收入空间，留着慢慢用。”

出了植物园，王建新开上车继续转悠。

Wang Jianxin walked on the streets of Batumi, feeling the wind blowing from the Black Sea.It's humid and warm, completely different from the dry and cold conditions in Moscow.He looked at the trees on the roadside. Some of them had sprouts sprouting, and there was green on the grass.

"This should be a subtropical area." Wang Jianxin thought to himself, "There should be more plants here, right?"

He looked at the cars running on the street, and they were still the same brands that were common in the Soviet Union - Lada, Muscovite, Gas, nothing new.He took out the GAZ 69 from the space and continued to drive around the city.

Batumi is not particularly big.It’s not comparable to Moscow, but it’s more lively than Ulaanbaatar.There are many people on the street, wearing thin coats, not as tightly wrapped as in the north.

Wang Jianxin drove around the city and found that agriculture was relatively developed here.There are large areas of farmland and orchards in the suburbs, and the tropical humid climate is very suitable for planting.As he drove, he looked at the sea. There were many large and small ships parked in the port, including cargo ships, fishing boats, and passenger ships, with numerous masts.

"I want to build a boat." Wang Jianxin looked at those boats and felt itchy in his heart.But after thinking about it, I really don’t have the space to put it.You can't put such a big boat in the river, right?Forget it, let’s talk about it later.

As he drove, he passed by a large planting base.The base occupies a large area and is surrounded by walls. There are greenhouses, open-air orchards, and test fields inside. It looks quite formal.There is a sign at the door, written in Georgian and Russian, which is probably some agricultural research institution.

Wang Jianxin found a deserted place, put the car into the space, and then sneaked in.

Once inside, he was attracted by what was inside.

There are so many types of fruit trees.Oranges, tangerines, oranges, lemons, grapefruits, one by one, are covered with fruits.Golden oranges, orange-red tangerines, and yellow lemons are so heavy that the branches are bent.There are also grapes, figs, pomegranates, persimmons, apples, pears and plums, many of which are ripe and fragrant.

Further inside, there is a large berry area.Strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, ridge after ridge, red, black, purple, hanging densely on the vines.Wang Jianxin picked a strawberry and put it in his mouth. It was sweet, with a little sourness, and delicious.

What surprised him the most was the tea tree.A large tea garden, neat tea trees, green leaves glowing in the moonlight.The brand says the varieties: black tea, green tea, oolong tea, flower and fruit tea, blackberry tea, all kinds are available.

"Fortunately, they all have introductions." Wang Jianxin took notes while reading. "Otherwise, he wouldn't know what these are."

There is also a large vegetable area there.There are so many varieties of potatoes, tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, bell peppers, beans, okra, cabbage, onions, garlic, carrots.

"This seems to be a place for scientific research." Wang Jianxin walked around the base. The area is so large, with fruit trees, tea trees, vegetables, and berries growing everything. It should be an institution like a botanical garden.

Take action while it's dark.

He first came to the fruit tree area and dug five of each type of oranges, tangerines, oranges, lemons, and grapefruits.Grapes, figs, pomegranates, persimmons, apples, pears, and plums, five of each.These trees range from big to small, and the big ones have grown into giant trees with large root balls that are difficult to dig.But Wang Jianxin, who is on the third level of Qi Refining, is so strong that when he puts down the shovel, the soil will turn up.After digging for more than two hours, all the fruit saplings were finally dug out and put into space.

Then there is the tea tree.Black tea, green tea, oolong tea, flower and fruit tea, blackberry tea, five of each.Tea trees are easier to dig than fruit trees. The roots are not deep and can be lifted out with a spade.He put tea saplings and fruit saplings together and planted them when he returned.

In the berry section, he also got some of everything.Strawberries, raspberries, blackberries, and blueberries, dig them out with the roots and soil and put them in pots.

After finishing the fruit trees and tea trees, he ran to the vegetable area.There is no need to dig out seedlings for vegetables, just pick the mature ones.I picked a lot of tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, bell peppers, beans, okra, and cabbage.Onions, garlic, carrots, uprooted.Then transplant some vegetable seedlings into the space - choose the ones that are strong and strong, dig them out with the soil and roots, and plant them in the open space beside the space river.

"First, I got a lot of mature vegetables and transplanted some of them into the space."

Continue wandering around the base.In such a large plantation, there are many unrecognizable trees and shrubs.Some were ornamental and some were economic trees. Wang Jianxin didn't care about so many. He looked at the ones that were suitable in size and beautiful, so he dug up a few trees and planned to plant them beside the space river as greenery.

For the rest, he saw large areas of wheat and barley.In the endless wheat fields, the wheat ears have turned yellow and are about to be harvested.

"We don't need these." Wang Jianxin shook his head.Wheat has been planted in the space, which is enough to eat.Moreover, there were mountains of flour collected from the Soviet Union, which would take more than a few lifetimes to finish.

He walked around and found the office area.A row of bungalows with offices, laboratories, and warehouses.He first found the warehouse and found that there was a seed bank inside - various vegetable seeds, berry seeds, and fruit seeds, stored in cabinets by category.He rummaged through and found seeds from tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplants, bell peppers, beans, okra, cabbage, onions, garlic, carrots, and seeds from strawberries, prunes, blueberries, and raspberries.

“Save all the income space and use it slowly.”

After leaving the botanical garden, Wang Jianxin got in his car and continued driving around.
